name: google-gemini-effect

frames.best_why: The five coloured paths are drawn furthest across the stage, showing the effect at its peak.

tagline: Five thin coloured lines sweep across a dark hero and stretch as you scroll.
summary: A full-width black hero with a large gradient headline, a short grey subtitle and a small white pill button, crossed by five thin curved lines in blue, cyan, pink and cream that draw outward from the centre on scroll.
appearance: A black full-width stage with a large white-to-grey gradient headline, two lines of small grey copy and a small white pill button in the centre. Five thin curved lines in blue, cyan, pink and cream sweep across the middle from both sides and blur into a soft glow where they meet.
behaviour: Scrolling draws the five curved lines outward from the centre and stretches them across the stage while the headline stays pinned. The copy and button do not move.
demo_content: Headline Build with Aceternity UI, a line about five paths drawing themselves, and a ui.aceternity.com button.
search_phrases: five lines that draw on scroll
dark landing page with glowing paths
animated hero section with svg lines
lines that grow as you scroll
use_when: A launch or product hero that should feel alive while the visitor scrolls deeper into the page.
avoid_when: Placed without a tall sticky scroll area, it shows only static lines and empty space below.
customise: Pass five motion values as pathLengths plus your own title and description; the button label, line colours and the path shapes are hardcoded.
weight_why: Five SVG paths driven by scroll values; no continuous animation loop.

a11y.note: The pill button has no click handler and the scroll animation ignores reduced-motion preferences.

issues: The white button reads ui.aceternity.com but has no click handler.
The SVG is fixed at 1440 by 890, so the paths drift off-centre on narrow screens.
The drawing is subtle; frames 1 and 6 differ only slightly at the edges.
polish_why: Striking dark hero with fine line work; the button is inert and the scroll change is faint.
